description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: A diverse, sustainable, competitive MFI sector with expanded outreach Indicator: At least 5 sustainable MFIs established or expanded with MFF support, including establishment of appropriate accuonting and MIS systems and credit procedures (Dec 2008) Data Source: BOL program monitoring reports; MFF and consultant progress reports; MFF audit reports; progress reporting by ADB missions

Output: A diverse, sustainable, competitive MFI sector with expanded outreach Indicator: Development and implementation of sustainable systems and procedures in the MFF (accounting, MIS, standard contract, application and review procedures) (April 2007) Data Source: BOL program monitoring reports; MFF and consultant progress reports; MFF audit reports; progress reporting by ADB missions
Output: A diverse, sustainable, competitive MFI sector with expanded outreach Indicator: Estabilshed MFF (Apr 2007) Data Source: BOL program monitoring reports

Output: A diverse, sustainable, competitive MFI sector with expanded outreach Indicator: Increased number of MFIs established in ethnic group areas (Dec 2008) Data Source: BOL program monitoring reports; MFF and consultant progress reports; MFF audit reports; progress reporting by ADB missions

Output: A diverse, sustainable, competitive MFI sector with expanded outreach Indicator: Increased number of clients (including poor clients, female clients, and ethnic group clients) served by MFIs (Dec 2008) Data Source: BOL program monitoring reports; MFF and consultant progress reports; MFF audit reports; progress reporting by ADB missions

Output: A diverse, sustainable, competitive MFI sector with expanded outreach Indicator: Microfinance best practices disseminated to MFIs and local officials (Dec 2007) Data Source: BOL program monitoring reports; MFF and consultant progress reports; MFF audit reports; progress reporting by ADB missions

Output: APB restructured, restored to financial health, and operating on a commercial and autonomous basis with extended outreach Indicator: APB progressively recapitalized per its governance agreement (Jun 2009) Data Source: APB financial statements and audit reports; APB Board resolutions Baseline value: 100

Output: APB restructured, restored to financial health, and operating on a commercial and autonomous basis with extended outreach Indicator: APB's ICT and related management information and risk management systems upgraded and operational (Jun 2008) Progress/Status: This project component comprises Phase 1 and Phase 2. Under Phase 1, data migration to the new system in 2 APB branches, namely, Vientiane Provincial Branch and Bolikamxay Branch and their service offices, and the installation of the hardware and software, test run, and start of operations through the new system are conducted in accordance with the turn-key contract between APB and 3i Info Tech. Phase 2 activities are to roll out the data migration and system the hardware and software, test run, and start of operations through the new system are conducted in accordance with the turn-key contract between APB and 3i Info Tech. Phase 2 activities are to roll out the data migration and system installation and functioning in the remaining 15 branches and their service offices by APB. Data migration in Phase 1 started in Sep 2010 and completed in Feb 2011 for the parallel system mode. Under the current parallel system mode, the new system does not work properly and APB had requested 3i Infotech for adequate inputs to complet Phase 1 by end 2011 in its letter of 6 Oct 2011. Data Source: ICT bidding and procurement documents; Progress reporting by ADB missions; Consultant and APB progress reports Baseline value: Y

Output: APB restructured, restored to financial health, and operating on a commercial and autonomous basis with extended outreach Indicator: APB's human resources strengthened through (i) performance standards and a performance assessment systems, (ii) bonus scheme to reward performance, and (iii) training (Jun, Dec 2007) Data Source: Consultant and APB progress reports Baseline value: Y

Output: APB restructured, restored to financial health, and operating on a commercial and autonomous basis with extended outreach Indicator: APB's restructuring plan completed and terms of governnance agreement, including achievement of performance indicators, adhered to (Dec 2008) Data Source: BOL inspection and assessment reports; consultant and APB progress reports; APB financial statements and audit reports Baseline value: Y

Output: APB restructured, restored to financial health, and operating on a commercial and autonomous basis with extended outreach Indicator: Composition of APB's Board and management strengthened (Jun 2007) Data Source: Progress reporting by ADB missions Baseline value: Y

Output: APB restructured, restored to financial health, and operating on a commercial and autonomous basis with extended outreach Indicator: Formulation and implementation of APB credit and risk management strategies (Jun 2007) Data Source: Progress reporting by ADB missions; Consultant and APB progress reports Baseline value: Y

Output: APB restructured, restored to financial health, and operating on a commercial and autonomous basis with extended outreach Indicator: Improved accounting and MIS policies and procedures implemented (Dec 2007) Data Source: Progress reporting by ADB missions; Consultant and APB progress reports Baseline value: Y

Output: APB restructured, restored to financial health, and operating on a commercial and autonomous basis with extended outreach Indicator: Interest subsidies and pollicy lending phased out from APB and all of APB's lending carried out on a commercial basis (Dec 2007) Data Source: APB Board resolutions; APB policy documents Baseline value: Y

Output: BOL capacity enhanced to effectively apply the regulatory and supervisory regime to MFIs Indicator: Chart of accounts and financial reporting accounting standards for MFIs (Jun 2007) Progress/Status: The new microfinance regulations approved in Jun 2008 include chart of accounts and financial reporting accounting standards. Data Source: Chart of accounts; progress reporting by ADB missions

Output: BOL capacity enhanced to effectively apply the regulatory and supervisory regime to MFIs Indicator: Establishment of BOL microfinance supervision division with adequate staffing (Aug 2004) Progress/Status: Established on 4 Dec 2003. Copy of establishment and structure and strategy of supervision was supplied to ADB in Mar 2007 mission. Data Source: Documentary evidence of establishment of the division and hiring of staff

Output: BOL capacity enhanced to effectively apply the regulatory and supervisory regime to MFIs Indicator: Monthly off-site monitoring and semi-annual on site supervision of MFIs (Beginning Dec 2005) Progress/Status: Since Sep 2007, BOL has conducted monthly off-site monitoring of the 3 pilot SCUs (Seno, Vientiane, Luangprabang) using the Microfinance Supervision Manual approved for testing by BOL in Aug 2007 and later approved for mandatory use in Dec 2007. BOL now has reports for Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec 2007, Jan, Feb 2008, and is continuing this monthly moniroting exercise. BOL has completed three onsite inspections of the 3 pilot SCUs (Sep 2005, Aug 2007, and Jan/Feb 2008). The last inspection included 3 MFIs and 5 SCUs. Data Source: BOL monitoring and supervision reports; BOL and consultant reports

Output: BOL capacity enhanced to effectively apply the regulatory and supervisory regime to MFIs Indicator: Supervision manuals, guidelines, and training materials (jun 2007) Progress/Status: Supplied to ADB in Mar 2007. Data Source: Manuals, guidelines, and training materials

Output: Enabling policies and strategy for rural and microfinance Indicator: An adopted financial sector strategy incorporating the adopted strategy for rual and microfinance (Dec 2007) Data Source: Monitoring and reporting on fulfillment of tranche release conditions by BOL; progress reporting by ADB missions Baseline value: Y

Output: Enabling policies and strategy for rural and microfinance Indicator: An approved and adopted policy for the development of sustainable rural and microfinance (Oct 2003) Data Source: Formally adopted policy and action plan of the Government Baseline value: Y

Output: Enabling policies and strategy for rural and microfinance Indicator: An established formalized framework for consultation between Government and the microfinance industry (Dec 2006) Data Source: RMFC action plan implementation progress reports and reports on industry consultations Baseline value: Y

Output: Sound prudential regulatory and supervisory environment for public and priate rural and microfinance institutions Indicator: APB IFRS financial statements puboished (Oct 2006; Sep 2007, Sep 2008) Data Source: Progress reporting by ADB missions

Output: Sound prudential regulatory and supervisory environment for public and priate rural and microfinance institutions Indicator: APB compliant with loan classification and provisioning regulations and with other regulations excluding capital adequacy and minimum capital (Dec 2005) Data Source: BOL monitoring and inspection reports; APB, SCU, and MFI audit reports

Output: Sound prudential regulatory and supervisory environment for public and priate rural and microfinance institutions Indicator: Adopted regulations, by-laws, guidelines, chart of account and accounting systems for SCUs and MFIs (Dec 2007) Data Source: APB IFRS financial statements; Monitoring and reporting on fulfillment of tranche release conditions by BOL

Output: Sound prudential regulatory and supervisory environment for public and priate rural and microfinance institutions Indicator: BOL directive applying the prudential regulations for commercial banks to APB (Jul 2005) Data Source: Published BOL regulations and instructions; BOL monitoring and inspection reports

Output: Sound prudential regulatory and supervisory environment for public and priate rural and microfinance institutions Indicator: BOL regulation that allows banks to make unsecured microfinance loans (Dec 2007) Data Source: Amended Commercial Banking Law; Official Gazette

Output: Sound prudential regulatory and supervisory environment for public and priate rural and microfinance institutions Indicator: Implementation of monthly off-site monitory and semi-annual on-site inspection of APB, SCUs, and MFIs (Dec 2005) Data Source: Progress reporting by ADB missions; Monitoring and reporting on fulfillment of tranche release conditions by BOL

Output: Supportive non-prudential regulations for rural and microfinance Indicator: An investment environment exempting MFIs from interest rate ceilings for microfinance loans (Aug 2006) Data Source: Monitoring and reporting on fulfillment of tranche release conditions by BOL; progress reporting by ADB missions
To promote a sustainable and marketoriented rural and microfinance sector

A diverse, sustainable, competitive MFI sector operational with appropriate support and incentives (December 2009) Progress/Status: Eligibility conditions, application procedures, approval process, terms and conditions of the contract have been approved. JFPR 9095 consultants provided training on awareness raising and microfinance best practices. Training modules provided included accounting, MFI business planning, and awareness raising. MFIs established. Data Source: Consultants' reports

A sound prudential regulatory and supervisory environment for public and private rural and microfinance institutions (June 2005) Progress/Status: BOL issued directive confirming that the prudential regulations for APB are the same as those for state-owned commercial banks, and (ii) instructions to APB to comply with prudential regulations on loan classification and provisioning starting Oct 2005 and to comply with all other prudential regulations other than capital adequacy and minimum capital requirements by Dec 2005. No. 154/BOL, 7 July 2005 Data Source: Official Gazette; BOL monitoring and inspection reports

A supportive non-prudential regulatory environment for rural and microfinance (August 2006) Progress/Status: The Standing Committee of the Lao National Assembly issued an interpretationof Article 46 of the Contractj Law that MFIs are exempted form interest rate ceilings. Data Source: APB, SCU, and MFI audit reports; APB financial statements and audit reports

APB transformed into a selfsustainable, market-oriented rural finance institution (December 2008) Progress/Status: APB restructuring plan is committed int he APB Governance Agreement. GA signed 30 march 2007. Implementation of Restructuring Plan commenced immediately. Data Source: Monitoring and reporting on fulfillment of tranche release conditions by BOL

An enabling policy framework for public and private provision of rural and microfinance (October 2003) Progress/Status: PMO endorsed a "Policy Statement for the Development of Sustainable Rural and Microfinance" establishing the Government's policy to support the development of a sustainable and market oriented rural and microfinance sector. No. 1760/PMO.S, 17 Dec 2003 Data Source: Formally adopted or issued policies, strategy, action plan, regulations, amended laws and decrees

BOL capacity enhanced to effectively apply the regulatory and supervisory regime to APB and MFIs (December 2007) Progress/Status: BOL regulation no. 256/12 May 2004 provides regulations, by-laws and guidelines for the offsite and onsite supervision of pilot SCUS in accordance with international best practice. BOL established a microfinance supervision division on 4 Dec 2003 that is now adequately staffed. BOL regulation no. 10/22 Jun 2005 was issued in which BOL adopts and implements microfinance regulations based on best practice principles for regulation and supervision of microfinance, including allowing for multiple MFI models and products with minimum starting regulations, interest rate autonomy, and private ownership. BOL started inspection in 2004 of SCUs and MFIs and was also applied in 2005. A strategic plan for supervision of SCUs and MFIs 2006-2010 is in place, including work programs and programs for training and capacity building. FIRST initiative consultants have started revision of the MFI/SCU regulations to assist the BOL in regining the existing regulations. Data Source: Progress monitoring and reporting by BOL; Progress reporting by ADB missions
